candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
Mining costs have very little correlation with metals prices and hence share prices.

Not until years down the road, when low prices (relative to those higher costs) eventually cure low prices.

IMO, if this hurts higher-cost producers now, that's a good reason to avoid them.
